name: explicit-range-resolves-target
description: When the user gives an explicit date range, the skill uses it verbatim, states the resolved range, and targets the one-file-per-week path under the reviews directory using the correct section order — Summary first, then Performance.
prompt:
Give me a weekly summary from 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-05.

You have no network or tool access in this environment — do NOT call any tools.
Just tell me the resolved date range, the exact target file path you would write
to, and the section order of the review from top to bottom.

assertions.description: targets the per-week file under the reviews directory
names the Summary block that opens the file
includes the Signal section in the described order
closes the order with the Values section
